clue.text: Give voice about a holiday-maker speeding

indicators.note: about tells us one word sits around another, so the singing goes round the camper

parts.note: to give voice is to sing
a camper is someone on holiday under canvas

explanation.surface: A loud holidaymaker races past.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' signals a container: the camper goes inside the word for giving voice, not round it.
explanation.definitionFit: Scampering is running quickly and lightly, like a small animal, so it is moving at speed.

clue.text: Very very fair

parts.note: so can mean very, as in so kind
so again means very

explanation.surface: Something rated extremely fair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fair' is meant in its middling sense, not as beautiful or just.
explanation.definitionFit: Fair here means middling or mediocre, which is exactly a so-so performance.

clue.text: Possibly name ten to get compensation

indicators.note: possibly says the letters could be arranged another way, so they are reshuffled

explanation.surface: A suggestion to name ten people to receive damages.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Possibly' rearranges all nine letters of NAME TEN TO.
explanation.definitionFit: Atonement is making amends for a wrong, a form of reparation or recompense.

clue.text: What irritates the first lady after a work-out

indicators.note: the first lady comes after the work-out, so her letters follow

parts.note: PE is physical education, a school work-out
Eve was the first woman in the Bible

explanation.surface: After exercise, a sore point annoys the leading lady.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'first lady' is not a President's wife but the Biblical Eve.
explanation.definitionFit: A peeve is a source of annoyance, a grievance that irritates.

clue.text: Spoil uppity boy and wild behaviour will result

indicators.note: in a down clue uppity reads the word going up, from bottom to top, so backwards

parts.note: to mar is to spoil
a page is a boy servant

explanation.surface: Indulge a cheeky boy and he will run riot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'uppity' turns MAR into RAM in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: A rampage is a spell of violent, unruly conduct.

clue.text: The most familiar are sent off

indicators.note: off suggests the letters have gone wrong or awry, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Those closest to us have been sent away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'off' rearranges ARE SENT.
explanation.definitionFit: The nearest people are the closest, those we know best.

clue.text: Little land is left. There's point to that

parts.note: taken as written; that the clue's 'is left' also spells the answer is a coincidence, as nothing signals a hidden word
E is a compass point, east

explanation.surface: Only a scrap of territory remains, which explains its sharp tip.
explanation.definitionFit: An isle is a small island, a modest piece of ground in the sea.

clue.text: Credit occupies a fool only a little

indicators.note: one thing occupying another sits inside it

parts.note: a sap is a gullible fool
CR is the accountancy abbreviation for credit

explanation.surface: A gullible person is given only a small loan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'occupies' signals a container; 'only a little' is the definition, so 'a' is just a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A scrap is a tiny piece or bit of something.

clue.text: Conclude cross is in an unsafe situation

parts.note: to end is to conclude
cross means angry, so angered

explanation.surface: Finishing up irritated puts someone in peril.
explanation.definitionFit: Something endangered is put at risk or under threat.

clue.text: These days hang over social worker and officer

parts.note: AD, anno domini, marks the present era
to jut is to project or overhang
the ant is a social insect and a proverbial worker

explanation.surface: Lately a social worker and an officer are left in suspense.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'social worker' is not a carer but the ant, which lives in colonies.
explanation.definitionFit: An adjutant is a military staff officer who assists a commander.

clue.text: Cut a number

definitions.meaning: to cut a line or notch into a surface

explanation.definitionFit: Scoring a surface marks it with a scratch, and twenty items make a score as a count.

clue.text: Are mended-put right -when twisted

indicators.note: putting something right reorders it, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Things are repaired once they have been bent back into shape.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put right' rearranges ARE MENDED.
explanation.definitionFit: A river that meandered wound and turned along a winding course.

clue.text: Waste time on a person getting the needle

indicators.note: time placed on the person means it follows after

parts.note: a sewer is someone who works with a needle
an age is a long period of time

explanation.surface: Losing time on someone who gets irritated or receives an injection.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting the needle' suggests annoyance or a jab, but means using a needle to sew.
explanation.definitionFit: Sewerage is drainage of sewage, the waste matter carried away in drains.

clue.text: A French writer obtaining release from imprisonment

parts.note: un is French for a
a pen is a writing instrument

explanation.surface: A French author is freed from jail.
explanation.definitionFit: To unpen is to let out of an enclosure, freeing what was confined.

clue.text: Striving to study nursing

parts.note: to con is to study or learn carefully
tending is caring for, as a nurse does

explanation.surface: Struggling to learn while caring for patients.
explanation.definitionFit: Contending means competing or struggling to achieve something.

clue.text: A poet in some confusion about the queen's function

indicators.note: about places the anagram around another piece
in confusion means jumbled up, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the queen

explanation.surface: A muddled poet worries about the monarch's role.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in some confusion' rearranges A POET into OPATE, and 'about' puts it round ER.
explanation.definitionFit: To operate is to work or run, as a machine does its job.

clue.text: Need coat replaced for spinning a tale

indicators.note: the letters are placed again in a new order

explanation.surface: A request for a new coat while telling a yarn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'replaced' rearranges NEED COAT.
explanation.definitionFit: An anecdote is a short amusing story about a real incident.

clue.text: Beginning to walk with a swaying motion? That's nonsense!

indicators.note: the beginning of the following word, to, is its first letter

parts.note: to waddle is to walk with a rolling, side-to-side gait

explanation.surface: A toddler starting to walk with a wobble talks rubbish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Beginning to walk' reads as a toddler's first steps, but 'Beginning' takes the first letter of 'to'.
explanation.definitionFit: Twaddle is silly, trivial talk, mere drivel.

clue.text: Make a speech Diana's way

parts.note: Di is the short form of Diana
a course is a way or route

explanation.surface: A princess's path is a talk.
explanation.definitionFit: To discourse is to speak at length on a subject, to hold forth.

clue.text: Summing up people

parts.note: those who tot up figures, read as people who add things together rather than appraise others

explanation.definitionFit: To tot up is to add, so those who tot are adders; the word also means people who wobble.

clue.text: The instrument of a crawler

definitions.meaning: an old bass wind instrument with a snaking shape
a snake that slithers along the ground

explanation.definitionFit: The serpent was a curved wooden horn of early church bands, and the word also names a snake.

clue.text: The painter is after dull quarters

indicators.note: is comes after dull, so its letters follow

parts.note: mat is a spelling of matt, meaning dull or not shiny
S and E, south and east, are compass quarters

explanation.surface: An artist follows a drab set of rooms.
explanation.walkthrough: 'quarters' suggests lodgings but means compass points.
explanation.definitionFit: Henri Matisse was a French painter, leader of the Fauves.

clue.text: A woman serving meals is flustered

indicators.note: flustered means agitated and confused, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A waitress bringing dinner gets in a fluster.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flustered' rearranges MEALS IS.
explanation.definitionFit: Melissa is a woman's given name.

clue.text: A drifter, certainly not without reason

parts.note: no is an emphatic refusal
mad means insane, lacking reason

explanation.surface: A wanderer who is definitely not irrational.
explanation.definitionFit: A nomad roams from place to place without a fixed home.

clue.text: A tree in blossom-a pleasing sight indeed

indicators.note: in shows the letters are found inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: A tree in flower is a lovely thing to see.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer runs across the join of BLOSSOM-A PLEASING.
explanation.definitionFit: The maple is a broad-leaved tree, source of maple syrup.

clue.text: Bond story

definitions.meaning: a connection or tie between things or people

explanation.definitionFit: A relation is a link between things, and relating a tale is telling it, so it is also a narration.

clue.text: Sound Oriental overlords going around the Occident

indicators.note: going around means encircling, so one piece goes inside another

parts.note: the Tang were a Chinese ruling dynasty
the Occident is the West, abbreviated W

explanation.surface: Eastern rulers circle the Western world noisily.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going around' puts W inside TANG.
explanation.definitionFit: A twang is a sharp ringing note, as from a plucked string.

clue.text: Ring before sun-up, which is a burden

indicators.note: ring comes before, so its letter leads

parts.note: a ring is O-shaped

indicators.note: in a down clue up reads the word from bottom to top, backwards

explanation.surface: Phoning before dawn is a heavy duty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns SUN into NUS in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: An onus is a responsibility or obligation one must bear.

clue.text: One member is neat as can be-such a bloomer

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
MP is a Member of Parliament

indicators.note: as can be suggests the letters can be in any order, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A tidy politician makes a blunder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bloomer' suggests a blunder but means a flowering plant; 'as can be' rearranges IS NEAT.
explanation.definitionFit: Impatiens is a genus of flowering plants, busy Lizzies.

clue.text: 6 where soldiers turned and fled

indicators.note: turned means turned round, so the letters are read backwards

parts.note: RA is the Royal Artillery
ran means fled

explanation.surface: An island where the troops turned and ran.
explanation.walkthrough: 6 refers to the answer at 6-across, an island. ARRAN is an island off the west coast of Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: Arran is a Scottish island in the Firth of Clyde.

clue.text: Joy's in the chorus

definitions.meaning: a part-song for male voices sung by a choir

explanation.definitionFit: Glee is delight, and a glee is also an unaccompanied part-song for several voices.

clue.text: They'll put the squeeze on many among the aliens

indicators.note: among puts one piece in the midst of another

parts.note: strangers are foreigners or aliens
L is the Roman numeral fifty, many

explanation.surface: A large number of foreigners will pressure someone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'among' puts L inside STRANGERS.
explanation.definitionFit: Stranglers kill by throttling, squeezing the throat.
